perspective:
From Brandon’s perspective, the information available to him is:

- He is Brandon Talayumptewa, an Alaska Native man, insurance agent, and bachelor’s degree holder. He is the professional advising Benjamin on business insurance.
- He meets Benjamin Erickson for the first time in a professional setting. He knows Benjamin is a man and entrepreneur seeking business insurance advice. He is aware Benjamin has limited formal education, so he worries about explaining complex insurance details clearly.
- In their first meeting, Benjamin says he wants comprehensive coverage and that some terms are new. Brandon explains liability insurance as a safety net, gives a slip-and-fall example, and explains asset protection for inventory/equipment. Benjamin asks for an example, asks about assets, and says it makes sense.
- In a later meeting, Brandon has revised his view of Benjamin’s ability to understand details and plans to go deeper. Benjamin says he is ready and has been reading up. Brandon explains business interruption insurance and property insurance including theft. Benjamin says these sound crucial and reassuring.
- At a lunch meeting, Brandon feels insecure about being too detail-focused and tries to be more engaging. He tells a joke about an entrepreneur insuring his taste buds. Benjamin says he appreciates thoroughness and lighter moments, finds the story fascinating, and relates it to assessing risk.
- In a subsequent meeting, Brandon feels pleased by Benjamin’s positive response to his anecdotes and decides to offer support beyond insurance. He suggests strategic investments and security upgrades to lower premiums. Benjamin says he hasn’t considered it, calls it smart/win-win, and agrees to explore further.
- In their final meeting, Brandon feels encouraged by their rapport and mutual benefits. He proposes co-developing a platform integrating risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs. Benjamin agrees, calls it groundbreaking, and agrees to draft initial plans.

Brandon does not have access to Benjamin’s private/internal thoughts, exact MBTI type, or any unstated details beyond what Benjamin said or Brandon observed.
